query: Establishment and long-term expansion of human fallopian tube epithelial organoids from surgical specimens
title: Establishing and Maintaining 3D Organoid Cultures From Human Fallopian Tube Epithelium
markdown:
## Protocol: Establishment and long-term expansion of human fallopian tube epithelial organoids from surgical specimens

### Overview

This protocol details the establishment and long-term expansion of human fallopian tube epithelial organoids from surgical specimens. The process involves reagent preparation, isolation of epithelial progenitors from fresh tissue, initial 2D culture, transfer to 3D organoid culture using extracellular matrix (ECM), long-term maintenance with passaging, and cryopreservation for future use.

### Materials/Reagents

Advanced DMEM/F12 (ADF), HEPES, GlutaMax, Penicillin/Streptomycin, Human recombinant EGF, Fetal calf serum (FCS), Y-27632 (ROCK inhibitor), Wnt3a conditioned medium, R-Spondin-1 conditioned medium, B27 or NCS21 supplement, N2 supplement, Human recombinant Noggin, Human recombinant FGF10, Nicotinamide, A83-01 (TGF-β inhibitor), Collagenase type I, DPBS, TrypLE Express, ECM (Extracellular Matrix), CryoSFM cryo medium, Gentamicin, Fungin, Sterile 0.1% BSA in DPBS. Alternative conditioned media: L-WRN cell line conditioned media, Noggin-secreting cell lines.

### Equipment

P1,000 pipette tip, P1000 pipette, 18 G needle, syringes, scalpel, surgical scissors, Petri dish, Falcon tubes (15 mL, 50 mL), T25 cell culture flasks, 24-well plates, 100 μm strainer, Neubauer Chamber or automated cell counter, centrifuge, water bath, Mr. Frosty or appropriate cryodevice, liquid nitrogen storage.

### Safety & Sterility

Primary human samples may contain pathogens; use appropriate protective equipment and barrier tips. Dissect samples within 2-3 hours after surgery. Filter freshly made media through a 0.22 μm filter to avoid contamination. Keep ECM on ice at all times. Do not extend thawing time unnecessarily as it decreases cell viability. Monitor detachment of cells during TrypLE incubation to minimize damage.

## Reagent Preparation

### Preparation: ADF+++

1. **1. ADF+++
**

Reagent Final concentration Quantity or Volume Advanced DMEM/F12 - 500 mL HEPES 10 mM 5 mL GlutaMax 1× 5 mL Penicillin/Streptomycin 1% (v/v) 5 mL [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S01 -->

### Preparation: FT isolation medium

1. Prepare FT isolation medium by adding 100 μL of 10 μg/mL human recombinant EGF stock, 5 mL of fetal calf serum, 100 μL of 10 mM Y-27632 stock, 1,000 μL of 1 M HEPES stock, 1,000 μL of GlutaMax (1×), 1,000 μL of Penicillin/Streptomycin (1% v/v), 100 μL of Fungin (0.1% v/v), and 100 μL of 10 mg/mL Gentamicin stock to Advanced DMEM/F12, then top up to 100 mL total volume. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T1-S01 -->
> **Operational constraint:** Filter the freshly prepared FT isolation medium through a 0.22 μm filter to avoid contamination and store at 4 °C for a maximum of two weeks. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T1-S02 -->

### Preparation: FT expansion medium

1. Prepare FT expansion medium by adding 25 mL of Wnt3a conditioned medium, 25 mL of R-Spondin-1 conditioned medium, 2 mL of B27 or NCS21 supplement, 1 mL of N2 supplement, 100 μL of 10 μg/mL human recombinant EGF stock, 100 μL of 100 μg/mL human recombinant Noggin stock, 100 μL of 100 μg/mL human recombinant FGF10 stock, 100 μL of 1 M Nicotinamide stock, 100 μL of 1 mM A83-01 stock, 100 μL of 10 mM Y-27632 stock, 1,000 μL of 1 M HEPES stock, 1,000 μL of GlutaMax (1×), and 1,000 μL of Penicillin/Streptomycin (1% v/v) to Advanced DMEM/F12, then top up to 100 mL total volume. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T2-S01 -->
> **Operational constraint:** Filter the freshly prepared FT expansion medium through a 0.22 μm filter to avoid contamination and store at 4 °C for a maximum of one week. Note that Wnt3a, R-Spondin-1, and Noggin conditioned media can be replaced by 25% conditioned media from the L-WRN cell line (ATCC, CRL-3276), and recombinant Noggin can be replaced by 10% (v/v) conditioned medium from Noggin-secreting cell lines. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T2-S02 -->

## Isolation of Epithelial Progenitors

### Tissue Collection and Dissection

> **Operational constraint:** Use appropriate protective equipment and barrier tips when handling primary human samples due to potential pathogen presence. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T0-S01 -->
> **Operational constraint:** Dissect fallopian tube samples within 2-3 hours after surgery. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T0-S02 -->
1. Coat all tubes with sterile 0.1% BSA in DPBS by applying the solution to all surfaces that come into contact with cells via up-and-down pipetting or decanting. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T0-S03 -->
2. Place the fallopian tubes in a Petri dish for dissection and cut the tissue into several pieces if it is too large to handle whole. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T0-S04 -->
3. Wash the tissue with DPBS to remove remnants of body fluids. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T0-S05 -->
4. Aspirate the DPBS from the washed tissue. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T0-S06 -->
5. Remove connective and vascular tissues from the fallopian tubes using a scalpel or surgical scissors. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T0-S07 -->
6. Open the fallopian tubes longitudinally to expose the mucosal folds using surgical scissors. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T0-S08 -->
7. Wash the inside of the opened fallopian tubes with DPBS. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T0-S09 -->
8. Aspirate the DPBS from the inside of the tubes. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T0-S10 -->
9. Scrape off epithelial cells from the submucosa into a Falcon tube by vigorously scraping three to five times along the lumen at a 45-60º angle using a disposable scalpel to minimize vertical pressure, or alternatively cut the tissue into approximately 0.5 mm³ pieces using a scalpel and/or surgical scissors. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T0-S11 -->

### Digestion and Filtration

1. Incubate the tissue pieces in 0.5 mg/mL collagenase type I in ADF for 45 min at 37 °C to dissociate epithelial cells from the extracellular matrix, using a total digestion volume of 10 mL. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T1-S01 -->
2. Filter the digested suspension through a 100 μm strainer into a 0.1% BSA-coated 50 mL tube to retain leftover tissue fragments. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T1-S02 -->
3. Transfer the filtered cell suspension to a coated 15 mL tube. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T1-S03 -->
4. Pellet the collected cells by centrifugation at 500× g for 5 min at 25 °C. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T1-S04 -->
5. Remove the supernatant from the pelleted cells. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T1-S05 -->
6. Wash the cell pellet with Advanced DMEM/F12 (ADF). [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T1-S06 -->
7. Pellet the collected cells again by centrifugation at 500× g for 5 min at 25 °C. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T1-S07 -->
8. Remove the supernatant from the washed cell pellet. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T1-S08 -->

### Initial Culture Establishment

1. Resuspend the cell pellet in FT isolation medium (Advanced DMEM/F12 containing 10 mM HEPES, 1% GlutaMax, 5% FCS, 10 ng/mL human EGF, 10 mM ROCK inhibitor, and 1% penicillin/streptomycin) and transfer the suspension to uncoated T25 cell culture flasks. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T2-S01 -->
2. Include 10 µg/mL gentamicin and 0.1% Fungin in the medium to avoid contamination. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T2-S02 -->
3. Incubate the cultures at 37 °C and 5% CO₂ in a humidified incubator. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T2-S03 -->
4. Monitor cultures regularly for growth and exchange the medium every 2 days. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T2-S04 -->
5. Once the cultures reach ~70% confluence, proceed to section **B** . [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T2-S05 -->

## Transfer to 3D Organoid Culture

### Preparation for 3D Seeding

1. Thaw an appropriate amount of ECM (up to 50 mL) on ice for subsequent usage. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T0-S01 -->
> **Operational constraint:** Keep ECM on ice at all times and prewarm 24-well plates at 37 °C. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T0-S02 -->
2. Prepare a bucket with ice. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T0-S03 -->
3. Cool down a centrifuge to 4 °C for subsequent steps. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T0-S04 -->
4. Prepare ADF+++ and FT expansion medium. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T0-S05 -->
5. Coat all 15 mL Falcon tubes with sterile 0.1% BSA in DPBS by applying the solution to all surfaces that come into contact with cells via up-and-down pipetting or decanting. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T0-S06 -->

### Cell Harvest and Counting

1. Aspirate the medium from the flask(s) containing the confluent cells. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T1-S01 -->
2. Wash the cells in each flask with 10 mL of DPBS. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T1-S02 -->
3. Aspirate the DPBS from the flasks. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T1-S03 -->
4. Detach the cells by incubating them for 5-10 min with 2 mL of TrypLE Express. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T1-S04 -->
> **Operational constraint:** Monitor the detachment of cells closely and keep the incubation time to a minimum to avoid damaging the cells. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T1-S05 -->
5. Harvest the detached cells by adding 10 mL of ADF+++ and transfer the cell suspension to a 15 mL Falcon tube. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T1-S06 -->
6. Pellet the collected cells by centrifugation at 300× g for 7 min at 4 °C. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T1-S07 -->
7. Aspirate the supernatant from the pelleted cells. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T1-S08 -->
8. Resuspend the cell pellet in an appropriate volume of ADF+++ to reach a total volume of 10 mL. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T1-S09 -->
9. Count the number of cells using a Neubauer Chamber or an automated cell counter. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T1-S10 -->
10. Calculate the number of wells, plates, and volume of ECM needed for subsequent seeding based on the cell count. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T1-S11 -->

### 3D Seeding

1. Pellet the collected cells by centrifugation at 300× g for 7 min at 4 °C. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T2-S01 -->
2. Aspirate the supernatant from the pelleted cells. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T2-S02 -->
3. Resuspend the cell pellet in an appropriate amount of ice-cold expansion medium. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T2-S03 -->
4. Add an appropriate amount of ECM to the cell/media suspension. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T2-S04 -->
5. Distribute the ECM/cell/media suspension in 50 μL droplets into each well of the prewarmed 24-well plates. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T2-S05 -->
6. Incubate the plates at 37 °C for 30-45 min to allow polymerization. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T2-S06 -->
7. Prewarm the expansion medium in a water bath to 37 °C. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T2-S07 -->
8. After polymerization of the ECM, overlay the droplets with 500 μL of prewarmed expansion medium. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T2-S08 -->
9. Incubate the plates at 37 °C and 5% CO₂ in a humidified incubator, changing the medium every 2-4 days, and monitor growth by standard light microscopy. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T2-S09 -->

## Long-term Maintenance and Passaging

### Passage Preparation

1. Thaw an appropriate amount of ECM on ice for subsequent usage. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T0-S01 -->
> **Operational constraint:** Keep ECM on ice at all times. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T0-S02 -->
2. Prewarm an appropriate number of 24-well plates at 37 °C. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T0-S03 -->
3. Prepare a bucket with ice. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T0-S04 -->
4. Cool down a centrifuge to 4 °C for subsequent steps. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T0-S05 -->
5. Prepare ADF+++ and FT expansion medium. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T0-S06 -->
6. Coat all 15 mL Falcon tubes, needles, and syringes with sterile 0.1% BSA in DPBS by applying the solution to all surfaces that come into contact with cells via up-and-down pipetting or decanting. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T0-S07 -->

### Passaging Procedure

1. Disrupt the ECM inside the medium in each well using a P1,000 pipette tip by scraping the ECM droplet inside the medium. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T1-S01 -->
2. Collect the contents of up to 12 wells into a single 15 mL Falcon tube. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T1-S02 -->
3. Add an appropriate amount of ice-cold ADF+++ to each 15 mL Falcon tube up to a total volume of 12 mL (use 6 mL of ADF+++ if processing 12 wells). [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T1-S03 -->
4. Close the tubes and invert them to mix the suspension. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T1-S04 -->
5. Pellet the collected cells by centrifugation at 300× g for 5 min at 4 °C. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T1-S05 -->
6. Aspirate the supernatant from the pelleted cells. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T1-S06 -->
7. Add 1 mL of TrypLE Express to the pellet and resuspend. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T1-S07 -->
8. Incubate the suspension for 5 min at 37 °C in a water bath. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T1-S08 -->
9. Fragment the organoids by up-and-down pipetting using a coated syringe with an 18 G needle. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T1-S09 -->
10. Add an appropriate amount of ice-cold ADF+++ to each 15 mL Falcon tube up to a total volume of 12 mL. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T1-S10 -->
11. Pellet the collected cells by centrifugation at 300× g for 5 min at 4 °C. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T1-S11 -->
12. Aspirate the supernatant from the pelleted cells. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T1-S12 -->
13. Add an appropriate amount of ice-cold ADF+++ and resuspend the pellet. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T1-S13 -->
14. Add an appropriate amount of ECM to the cell/media suspension. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T1-S14 -->
15. Distribute the ECM/cell/media suspension in 50 μL droplets into each well of the prewarmed 24-well plates. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T1-S15 -->
16. Incubate the plates at 37 °C for 30-45 min to allow polymerization. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T1-S16 -->
17. Prewarm the expansion medium in a water bath to 37 °C. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T1-S17 -->
18. Overlay the polymerized droplets with 500 μL of prewarmed expansion medium. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T1-S18 -->
19. Incubate the plates at 37 °C and 5% CO₂ in a humidified incubator. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T1-S19 -->

## Cryopreservation

### Organoid Freezing

1. Let organoids grow for 5-7 days until they are proliferative and approximately 100-200 μm in size. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B05-T0-S01 -->
2. Prepare a bucket with ice. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B05-T0-S02 -->
3. Cool down a centrifuge to 4 °C for subsequent steps. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B05-T0-S03 -->
4. Coat all 15 mL Falcon tubes with sterile 0.1% BSA in DPBS by applying the solution to the inner walls via up-and-down pipetting or decanting. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B05-T0-S04 -->
5. Follow the Passaging Procedure steps up to step 6 (collecting and washing organoids). [1] <!-- protocol-step:B05-T0-S05 -->
6. Add 1 mL of CryoSFM cryo medium for every 4 wells of organoids and resuspend the suspension. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B05-T0-S06 -->
7. Aliquot the suspension into cryovials with 1 mL per vial. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B05-T0-S07 -->
8. Place the cryovials in -80 °C in an appropriate cryodevice (e.g., Mr. Frosty). [1] <!-- protocol-step:B05-T0-S08 -->
9. Transfer the cryovials to liquid nitrogen the next day. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B05-T0-S09 -->

### Organoid Thawing

1. Thaw an appropriate amount of ECM on ice for subsequent usage. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B05-T1-S01 -->
2. Prewarm an appropriate number of 24-well plates at 37 °C. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B05-T1-S02 -->
3. Prepare a bucket with ice. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B05-T1-S03 -->
4. Cool down a centrifuge to 4 °C for subsequent steps. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B05-T1-S04 -->
5. Prepare ADF+++ and FT expansion medium. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B05-T1-S05 -->
6. Coat all 15 mL Falcon tubes with sterile 0.1% BSA in DPBS by applying the solution to the inner walls via up-and-down pipetting or decanting. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B05-T1-S06 -->
7. Transfer the frozen organoids in the cryovial on ice to the laboratory. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B05-T1-S07 -->
8. Thaw the vial in a water bath at 37 °C. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B05-T1-S08 -->
> **Operational constraint:** Do not extend the thawing period unnecessarily, as it decreases cell viability. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B05-T1-S09 -->
9. Add 11 mL of ice-cold ADF+++ into a coated 15 mL Falcon tube. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B05-T1-S10 -->
10. Resuspend the CryoSFM/organoid mixture in the cryovial and transfer it to the 15 mL Falcon tube. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B05-T1-S11 -->
11. Pellet the collected cells by centrifugation at 300× g for 5 min at 4 °C. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B05-T1-S12 -->
12. Aspirate the supernatant from the pelleted cells. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B05-T1-S13 -->
13. Add an appropriate amount of ice-cold ADF+++ and resuspend the pellet. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B05-T1-S14 -->
14. Add an appropriate amount of ECM to the cell/media suspension. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B05-T1-S15 -->
15. Distribute the ECM/cell/media suspension in 50 μL droplets into each well of the prewarmed 24-well plates. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B05-T1-S16 -->
16. Incubate the plates at 37 °C for 30-45 min to allow polymerization. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B05-T1-S17 -->
17. Prewarm the expansion medium in a water bath to 37 °C. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B05-T1-S18 -->
18. Overlay the polymerized droplets with 500 μL of prewarmed expansion medium. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B05-T1-S19 -->
19. Incubate the plates at 37 °C and 5% CO₂ in a humidified incubator. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B05-T1-S20 -->
